rows.name: Ship core
rows.tradeOff: The heart: steering, the jump drive and a battery. One per ship

rows.name: Battery
rows.tradeOff: the ship's pool: holds and gives quickly

rows.name: Burst
rows.tradeOff: bursts near what it passes · ammo
mounting: Bolts on at its side only

rows.name: Afterburner
rows.tradeOff: weak cruise, huge boost; wants a Drive Cell touching it

rows.name: Capacitor
rows.tradeOff: touching Capacitors form a bank that feeds the guns, beams, miners and Flash Screens it touches first; it does not feed engines

rows.name: Torch
rows.tradeOff: full thrust all the time, no boost, burns energy

rows.name: Joiner Bank
rows.tradeOff: A battery that joins two lines into one

rows.name: Splitter Bank
rows.tradeOff: A battery that splits one line into two

rows.name: Glint
rows.tradeOff: a long pulse you time, reaches far

rows.name: Drive Cell
rows.tradeOff: touching Drive Cells form a bank that feeds the engines and strafers it touches first

rows.name: Burst Strafer
rows.tradeOff: a hard dodge away from its nozzle, short cooldown; no cruising push, big draw
rows.keyNumbers: dodge 14.0 push · every 0.4 s · 140 energy a burst · draws 700 bursting

rows.name: Passthrough
rows.tradeOff: A power line with a pipe through it, side to side

rows.name: Point Defence Turret
rows.tradeOff: shoots down missiles on its own; never ships
rows.keyNumbers: 5.0 shots/s at missiles · reach 560 · auto · draws 10

rows.name: Twinlink
rows.tradeOff: the only cannon turret: 16 rounds, then a short reload

rows.name: Tow Beam
rows.tradeOff: tows wrecks and pods to salvage; slows you by their mass

rows.name: Combiner
rows.tradeOff: Joins a feed to a power line

rows.name: Frostbite Lance
rows.tradeOff: a held freeze beam; slows what it lights by 40% (thrust and turning)

rows.name: Flash Screen
rows.tradeOff: no slow refill, back whole after a break

rows.name: Needle
rows.tradeOff: fast slugs through two ships · ammo

rows.name: Chainsaw
rows.tradeOff: a hose: hard to dodge, harder to power
rows.keyNumbers: 80 dmg/s · reach 5,400 · cycle · spins up · draws 21

rows.name: Jump Coil
rows.tradeOff: more jump for a bigger hull

rows.name: Hush
rows.tradeOff: switches one ship off for 2 s

rows.name: Cloudmaker
rows.tradeOff: placed clouds at your aim distance, slow reload
mounting: Bolts on at its side only

rows.name: Selector
rows.tradeOff: Two feeds in (left and right), one out (front)

rows.name: Repair Beam
rows.tradeOff: mends allies' parts; nothing for you, big draw

rows.name: Spark
rows.tradeOff: instant zap, chains to 3 more ships

rows.name: Fusion Plant
rows.tradeOff: plenty of power, heavy, big blast

rows.name: Pulse Dynamo
rows.tradeOff: puts 10 a second into each bank it touches, no wires

rows.name: Cutter
rows.tradeOff: burns deeper the longer it stays on one part, short reach
rows.keyNumbers: 150 dmg/s · reach 900 · held beam · ramps up · draws 32

rows.name: Flicker Screen
rows.tradeOff: thin and cheap, back in a second

rows.name: Longbarrel
rows.tradeOff: a sniper's cannon: far, slow to fire

rows.name: Long-Range Array
rows.tradeOff: twice the reach, twice the power

rows.name: Heavy Bank
rows.tradeOff: deep but slow: endurance, not alpha strikes

rows.name: Heavy Gyro
rows.tradeOff: A big reaction wheel for big ships

rows.name: Swarm
rows.tradeOff: six small rockets a salvo, floods point defence · ammo
mounting: Bolts on at its side only

rows.name: Coilgun
rows.tradeOff: five slugs in a cone, close range · no ammo

rows.name: Overpulse
rows.tradeOff: dumps a clip of bolts into shields, barely scratches hull

rows.name: Searchlight
rows.tradeOff: reaches furthest, marks what it lights for 20% more damage
mounting: Bolts on at its side only

rows.name: Spear
rows.tradeOff: three ships at full damage, 120 E a shot

rows.name: Tesla
rows.tradeOff: held storm: 5 zaps a second, chains to 5
mounting: Bolts on at its side only

rows.name: Rail Driver
rows.tradeOff: semi-auto rifle: six shots, then a 1.5 s reload

rows.name: Bastion
rows.tradeOff: two huge dodgeable shells, then a long reload

rows.name: Heavy Coil
rows.tradeOff: more jump per cell, and 20% faster to cool

rows.name: Lance
rows.tradeOff: the heaviest held beam at point blank; sputters short of power
rows.keyNumbers: 210 dmg/s · reach 500 · held beam · winds up · draws 90
